title: spec gap report
description: Written by merge_gaps only. Gaps are reported, never decided: owner-decides needs the project owner or lead agent; fixable has one obvious correction.

sizing_notes.description: Work-packet notes against config sizing.packet_tokens, for the owner; never a gap or a gate. Item size against config sizing is judged by the plan agent.

reviewed_head.description: HEAD at the last review's write: a re-review is given the diff since it and the open findings.

answered.description: Owner questions settled by a cited decision or overlay rule ({gap, answered_by, date}); not blocking.

re_asked.description: Owner questions a decision or overlay rule already covered that cite nothing ({gap, covered_by}); not blocking.

learning.description: Per cycle counts: owner questions opened, answered, re-asked after a covering decision existed; overlay candidates. Facts, never scored.

value.description: Sellable at HEAD, if-stopped-today, cost to the next sellable feature, unvalued features. Facts, never scored.

packets.description: Work packet size in tokens per item (largest first, capped).

facts.description: Structure facts for the owner (split parent without a child dependency, shared path, tracker-closed item not met, never scored, tracker unreachable); they change no status.

quote.description: Text on the cited line; a finding whose quote is not there is rejected.

looked_in.description: Documents searched, for a gap that is an absence.

resolve_with.description: Skill that settles it (e.g. the catalog's decision or vetting skill); reported, not run.

blocks.description: Items this gap stops from ever being met; they are reported blocked, not built.

unlocated.description: A mechanical check found no line to cite.

impact.description: Ids of the targets or acceptance checks the finding touches; more first when ranked.

rule.description: Catalog rule id or document rule the finding cites.

proof.description: How the gap was shown (the finding schema's evidence): ranks, never filters.

reopens.description: Path or id of the recorded decision (config standards.decisions) this gap would reopen; listed in its own report section for the owner.

state.description: Findings only (source finding): default open; a re-review is given the open ones.

answered_by.description: Id of the decision record (D-n) or overlay rule that settles this gap's kind and area; merge_gaps checks the cite and lists the gap as answered instead of blocking.
